5A

Describe clothes and actions now
Actions happening now
5A
Now
Subject	Positive	Negative	Yes/no question
I	I am reading.	I am not reading.
I’m not reading.
	Am I reading?
he, she, it	She is reading.	She is not reading.
She isn’t reading.
	Is she reading?
you, we, they	They are reading.	They are not reading.
They aren’t reading.
	Are they reading?
Usually

I wear black.

Now

I’m wearing blue.

1 Choose and circle.
Look! Leo am / is / are wearing a red hat.
I am / is / are looking for my bag.
We am / is / are waiting for the bus.
Am / Is / Are Sara buying a coat?
2 The underlined words are wrong. Rewrite each sentence.
She wearing new shoes.
They isn’t talking.
Is he reading? Yes, he are.
3 Usually or now? Complete with the correct form.
Usually, I  (wear) black. Today, I  (wear) blue.
Mia  (work) in a café every day. Now, she  (eat) lunch.
4 Look around. Write one thing you are doing and one thing you aren’t doing.

6B
My dream home
Describe a home and compare rooms
Where is it?
6B
in
on
under
next to
above
in front of

The ball is in the box.

The ball is in front of the box.

1 Cover the six labels. Take turns. Point to a picture and say the preposition.

Your partner checks the label. Try all six pictures.

2 Room check. Read the facts. Correct the sentences.

The phone is on the table. The bag is under the table.

The chair is next to the sofa. The shoes are in the box.

The phone is under the table.
The bag is on the table.
The chair is in front of the sofa.
The shoes are next to the box.
3 On separate paper, draw a room with three objects. Choose one.

Don’t say its name. Write and say two sentences about where it is. Your partner points to the object.

7C
Life in the 80s
Tell a story from the past
Regular past verbs
Past statements, negatives and questions
7C
Positive (all subjects)	Negative	Yes/no question
She played music.	She did not play music.
She didn’t play music.
	Did she play music?
Avoid	Use
Did she was at home?	Was she at home?
Verb	play	live	study	plan
Past	played	lived	studied	planned
1 Write the past forms.
visit → 
work → 
live → 
study → 
plan → 
play → 
2 Read the note. Complete the diary with the verbs.
Saturday · music club
Leo: played the guitar; Sara: danced; Mia: stayed at home.
Leo  the guitar. (play)
Sara . (dance)
Mia  at home. (stay)
Mia  at the club. (not / dance)
3 Correct the past-form mistakes.
I studyed on Sunday.
We didn’t played music.
Did she visited a friend?
4 Ask your partner two real questions about last weekend. Use different verbs. Write the questions and short answers.

Did you cook? Yes, I did. / No, I didn’t.

Use your partner’s answers. Do not look at their notes.

Verb	Past
arrive	arrived

Should / shouldn’t
Give useful advice
8B
Positive (all subjects)	Negative	Yes/no question
You should take a coat.	You should not take a coat.
You shouldn’t take a coat.
	Should you take a coat?
Avoid	Use
She should wears a coat.
She should to wear a coat.	She should wear a coat.
1 Match each situation with advice. Write a, b or c.
It’s raining. 
It’s very hot. 
It’s cold and windy. 

a You should take some water.

b You should wear a warm coat.

c You should take an umbrella.

2 Fix the advice questions and sentences.
Do I should take a coat?
You shouldn’t to go outside.
